summary: Verified new structured `alternatives` array on auto-rejected bookings + one-click Reapply UX end-to-end. Backend returns correct alternatives (same_room_later + other_room_same_time) with auto_rejected=true and preserves Indonesian rejection_reason text. Manually rejected bookings still return alternatives=[] and auto_rejected=false. Frontend /cek-status renders 'AJUKAN ULANG DENGAN SLOT ALTERNATIF' pills with correct data-testids; clicking navigates to /pesan with all expected URL params; the prefilled-banner appears and every form field (nim/nama/kelas/room/date/start/end/purpose) is pre-populated. Direct /pesan without query params correctly hides the banner and uses defaults (start=08:00, end=10:00, empty NIM/Nama/Kelas).
